therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Myeloablative conditioning for allogeneic bone marrow transplantation
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with acute myelogenous leukemia and myelodysplastic syndrome undergoing allogeneic bone marrow transplant
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Treatment-related mortality at 100 days and 1 year, and 3-year progression-free survival

results.effect_size: Median PFS: Fixed-dose 42 days (95% CI: 32-52) vs Adjusted-dose 56 days (95% CI: 45-66)
results.target_engagement_evidence: Pharmacokinetic studies performed to achieve daily AUC of 6,000 microMol-min ± 10%
biomarker_changes: Bone marrow blast <5% considered complete response
subgroup_findings: TRM at 100 days: Fixed-dose CR patients 3%, Not in CR 7%; Adjusted-dose CR patients 3%, Not in CR 3%
TRM at 1 year: Fixed-dose CR patients 19%, Not in CR 18%; Adjusted-dose CR patients 17%, Not in CR 3%
results.dose_information: Fixed dose: Busulfan 130 mg/m² IV daily x 4 days; Adjusted dose: 32 mg/m² test dose followed by PK-guided dosing; Fludarabine 40 mg/m² IV daily x 4 days

context.comparator: Fixed-dose busulfan vs PK-adjusted dose busulfan (both with fludarabine)
